description: Congo Inter’s “une cinquantaine” estimate for 14 Nov is approximate and does not establish a minimum of 50. Additional body-level corroboration and attendance evidence would resolve eligibility.
27 Nov Ngaba mobilization is body-confirmed and police-stopped, but attendance is not reported. Outlet/source independence is unverified; no count can be inferred from dispersal.
RTNC staff sit-in at the Primature on 7 Nov is body-confirmed and state-directed, but no participant count is available.
Sursaut National’s 14 and 27 Nov actions likely share an anti-revision campaign, but separate events are kept; the announced December gathering requires independent occurrence confirmation.
